notes.title: 🍓 Next Fest has started! 🍓
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44823033/ae9d6349546b530495052baa36c6da2b577a401d.png[/img]
🍓 Next Fest has started! 🍓

Our Mushroom Picker Simulator is taking part, and we really need your support!
Download the demo, play for at least 30 minutes, and leave a review — it truly matters.

We have ambitious plans to expand the Chushpan universe in a GTA-style direction — not copying, but reimagining it with the unique flavor and atmosphere of the post-Soviet world.
With humor, freedom of action, and that familiar absurdity.

If the demo gets enough attention, it will not only boost the Mushroom Picker Simulator, but also give Chushpan 3 a real chance at funding.
That's a big step toward a future where Chushpan 3 becomes reality.

You can also follow us on [url=https://t.me/sebasa_games]Telegram[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/ZGtg4EfzzJ]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SebasaGames]YouTube[/url], and the publisher's page to stay updated and catch some fun content!

Thank you for any support! 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3460890/Simulyator_Gribnika_Demo/

notes.title: Barbecue game release with friends
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44823033/31f5194d59e55e29b220df0e78f0893e8ee04e90.jpg[/img]
